title: Plan
description:
Preparation plan for one order (C-1 v3). Server -> hub; the hub runs it without interpreting values.
Sent inside GET /v1/hub/plans. A larger plan_version replaces the older one. (HUB-03, HUB-04)

devices_revision.description: Devices revision the plan was made with. The hub checks at run time that each cmd is still delegated (else blocked: not_delegated).

tasks.description: All live tasks of this version.

cancelled.description: Every task cancelled so far (cumulative across versions).

protective.description: Safety task (child lock, power cut). Released only when its end event is actually observed or it is cancelled; never at a time fallback (or_time / or_after). Set by the server from its command policy, never by the LLM (rules.md).

value.description: Absent when the command has no value_schema. An object of numbers / enum strings for parameter commands; a string only for value_schema 'text' (show_notice).

first_only.description: Run on the first matching event only.

window.description: Only events inside this window count.

released.description: package.brought_in only. false = wait; the server sends a new version with true once it links the delivery to this order (HUB-12).

at.description: With released true: when the package was brought in.

time.description: Absolute end (a household that changed the end point before).

by.description: Only an end event caused by this actor counts.

after.description: End this long after the end event.

or_time.description: End at this time if the end event never comes.

or_after.description: End this long after the trigger if the end event never comes.

restore.description: Put devices back to the saved state at the end.
true if the task had started: undo it.
